Main's checkout C:\Projects\ReST-GI (branch ecro_lr3_adapter, untracked experiments/ecro_live101j of another session) is used READ-ONLY for frozen sources, checkpoints and the Mitsuba 3.9.1 runtime; WL111 code and outputs live in the isolated C:\Projects\bench111.

Development smokes (dev111.py) compared only the new physical adapter with the WL100 finite-depth reference and measured raw frame times; they are disclosed in the worklog and are not evidence.

runtime_rule: One case runtime alive at a time (rt101 module-level closure table _CL belongs to the last-constructed runtime; found in the code-path smoke before evidence). States are processed grouped by case.

references.primary: REF_FULL: pt111 full depth (kmax 256 events, Russian roulette from event 4, q = min(max throughput, 0.95)), same scene semantics as pt100 (SSS entry-to-first-exit walk = one event, ballistic through-sphere NEE). Two independent halves (splitmix/sha seeds). Primary scores use the half mean; per-pixel reference variance = (h0 - h1)^2 / 4 is subtracted from MSE (debiased).
references.diagnostic: REF_D6: pt111 kmax 6 without RR = ECRO's depth-matched target (WL100 E1..E6 semantics), 2 halves. Diagnostic only; truncation stays in every primary score.
references.validity_gate: G_ADAPT: pt111 at kmax 6 without RR, 1024 spp, against the archived WL100 REF_0_{0,1} (2 x 4096 spp, independent code path pt100.trace) on S0 V0 and N0 V0: for e1, e2, h in every channel the image-mean difference passes (|relative difference| <= 3e-3 OR |z| <= 4, z = mean difference / pixel-level standard error of the difference image) and RMSE / expected noise lies in [0.75, 1.25]; and kmax 6 with RR 4 equals the no-RR adapter by the same mean rule. Fail = stop the fixture workloads.
references.validity_gate_development_note: Code-path smoke (before any evidence): the first written rule (|rel| <= 3e-3 without a noise term, RMSE/noise [0.85, 1.20]) failed on N0 only from heavy-tailed near-mirror noise: e1 matched to 2e-4 and two distributionally identical estimators (e2, unaffected by roulette) already differed by 0.6 %. The rule was changed to the noise-scaled form above before any evidence run; the smoke values are disclosed in the worklog.
references.full_depth_convergence: Reported: energy beyond 6 events (FULL - D6) per state; FULL halves agreement (half-vs-half RMSE).

arms.ECRO: Canonical ReST-GI as implemented (Architecture 2026-11-13): frozen WL100 checkpoint, WL101 optimized runtime (rt101.RT.frame, FREEZE=1), LOW E1+E2 physical + learned HIGH table lookup, D = 6. Static frames reuse the resident table; dynamic transitions use the WL101 selective lifecycle (set_geom, update_state, set_light, source, respond, DLPack hand-off, frame). Nothing tuned.
arms.ECRO_CONV: ECRO at 4096 spp, one replicate: the canonical estimator's converged bias (diagnostic).
arms.ECRO_STALE: Dynamic control: T1 geometry/light with the T0 table.
arms.PT: Practical full-depth physical path tracer (pt111), same scene semantics, megakernel symbolic loop frozen with dr.freeze, kmax 256, RR from event 4. No per-workload tuning.
arms.PTDN: PT + OptiX AI denoiser (Mitsuba 3.9.1 OptixDenoiser, HDR model, albedo + normal guides from the same samples, no temporal history), input passed on the device.

not_run_here.ECRO+denoiser: NOT_RUN: would be a new ReST-GI pipeline variant (WL101B SVGF candidate already failed its gate); outside this batch's no-new-variant rule.
not_run_here.8DNA / RNA / TransGI on the fixtures: UNSUPPORTED / UNQUALIFIED: see the registry. 8DNA: no released ECRO-room scene/asset; RNA: transparent-medium AOV failure (WL69) and no released production renderer; TransGI: no medium transport (glass and media removed in its scope).
not_run_here.NRC: IMPLEMENTATION_UNAVAILABLE in this repository (no executed implementation on any branch).

quality.seeds: seed_of('q111', state, view, arm, spp, rep) (sha256 -> splitmix64, < 2^40), stream = seed * 1000003 (+ launch); disjoint by construction from reference seeds ('ref111', ...).

metrics.primary: E = relative debiased HDR RMSE over the full frame against REF_FULL: sqrt(max(mean_rep MSE - mean ref variance, 0)) / mean(REF), linear RGB, all pixels (exposure 1). Expected per-frame error at an operating point = mean over replicates of MSE before the square root.
secondary: LDR RMSE / L1 / PSNR with clip(x,0,1)^(1/2.2)
metrics.uncertainty: Bootstrap over replicates (2,000 resamples, percentile 95 %) for E and ratios; reference noise via halves; timing: median with bootstrap CI over frames.

sss_gate.definitions: WL101C near / flank (V0: visible floor with world y <= 0.4; held-out: all azimuths, WL101G near_all / flank_all); near-minus-flank excess = (arm near - flank) - (REF near - flank) in Rec.709 luminance; signed near = arm near - REF near. WL101F material bands (near +-0.014030, contrast +-0.012520) were defined against the D6 Oracle excess and are reported for orientation only; this batch scores against REF_FULL.

timing.boundary: Static frame: from the call with all resident state ready to the per-pixel radiance (and, for PTDN, the denoised tensor) in GPU memory; dr.sync_thread + torch.cuda.synchronize before and after; perf_counter. First call (kernel recording/compile) reported separately. Display/presentation excluded for every arm.
timing.exclusivity: Windows WDDM lists desktop processes as GPU clients, so a block is exclusive when no other python.exe (other than this process and its venv launcher parent) runs and the median GPU utilization over 3 s is <= idle_util_max_pct, before and after the block; otherwise the block is repeated (max_attempts) and finally flagged contaminated. The desktop compositor shares the GPU; this is disclosed, not removable.

EDIT_S0_S1.class: rigid edit: both boxes move (WL100 test 0 -> test 1 geometry), sphere fixed

dynamic.boundary: edit -> first frame: from the new geometry/light parameters to the first 512^2 x 1 spp frame in GPU memory; ECRO_sel = WL101 selective lifecycle; ECRO_full = full relation rebuild; PT = BVH update + frame; PTDN = PT + denoiser. Each arm alternates T0 -> T1 -> T0 so arm boundaries always leave a consistent T0 state.
dynamic.quality_at_target: From the quality stage at S1 / SL (ECRO with the updated table, PT, PTDN) and the ECRO_STALE control here.
dynamic.untested_dynamic_classes: sphere translation, contact separation / formation, deformation, self-contact: UNSUPPORTED by the fixture family (sphere fixed) -> NOT_RUN; recorded in the SSS gate as missing evidence.

lr3.workload: W4 Living Room 3 static V0, 640 x 360, GI output semantics (WL102 contract): Ref-65 (Mitsuba 3.6.4 path max_depth 65, 2 x 65,536 spp, LabServer69, DI by common random numbers) is the primary GI reference; Ref-7 is depth-matched diagnostic. Metric: GI LDR RMSE (WL102 / TransGI convention) and GI relative debiased HDR RMSE.

arms.PT_LR3: Mitsuba 3.9.1 'path' max_depth 65 (RR default 5), GI = full(65) - full(2) with common random numbers per sample set; spp ladder 1..256; timing = one full-depth render (an upper bound of a GI-only pass).
arms.PTDN_LR3: PT_LR3 GI + OptiX denoiser (albedo / normal from Mitsuba aov).
arms.TransGI: Independent reproduction, adopted configuration B24 L40 (D_vis, LeakyReLU, t = 0.15 probe spacing, object-balanced batches, lazy Adam, latent init 1e-4), seed-1 checkpoint living_room_3_b10t/train/b24_lz_i4_seed1 (LabServer69, read-only copy). Quality: its own evaluator at 640x360; timing: its fast frame if it runs on Main, otherwise historical LabServer69 timing labelled cross-hardware.
arms.ECRO_LR3: WL102 Amendment-2 model (owner-approved seed s10202), quality from WL102 (historical, same Ref-65 contract), timing on Main if its adapter runs unchanged; otherwise historical labelled.

lr3.status_rule: Each LR3 arm is QUALIFIED only if it runs unchanged on Main with the stated inputs; a blocker is recorded and the remaining comparisons continue (brief stop rule).

frontier.rule: Per workload and view: points (median frame ms on Main, E with 95 % CI). Pareto front over all executed arms. Strongest valid comparator at the ReST-GI operating point = the executed arm with the lower E at equal time (log-log interpolation along its spp ladder) and, separately, the lower time at equal E. No averaging across workloads.
frontier.interpolation: Piecewise-linear in (log ms, log E) between adjacent executed spp; no extrapolation beyond executed points (reported as 'beyond executed range').

gate_derivation.status: PENDING_OWNER_APPROVAL. The numbers proposed in the worklog are derived from these measurements by the rule below; nothing becomes canonical without the owner.
gate_derivation.path1: Quality non-inferiority AND performance superiority, against the comparator Pareto frontier F (lowest E at each time over all valid executed comparators): PASS iff t_ReST <= (1 - s_t) * t_F(E_ReST / (1 + m_q)), where t_F(E) is the frontier time to reach error E (interpolated; 'beyond executed range' = not evaluable).
gate_derivation.path2: Performance non-inferiority AND quality superiority: PASS iff E_ReST <= (1 - s_q) * E_F(t_ReST / (1 + m_t)), where E_F(t) is the frontier error at time t.
gate_derivation.absolute: Independently of PATH 1/2, the owner's frame budgets apply to the ReST-GI operating point used for the claim (static frame and edit -> first frame reported separately).
gate_derivation.margin_assessment: Margins are assessed against measured replicate CI half-widths of E and timing CIs; a margin smaller than the 95 % CI half-width of the measured difference is reported as not resolvable at the measured precision (it is not silently widened).
gate_derivation.independence: Each workload / view tier must pass separately; the SSS near-contact gate is separate and cannot be compensated.

stops: G_ADAPT fails -> stop the fixture workloads (reference not qualified).
A required reference half disagrees beyond 2x its own noise (half-vs-half RMSE ratio) -> that state is UNQUALIFIED.
Timing block contaminated after max_attempts -> the timing comparison of that block is UNQUALIFIED (quality still reported).
An external arm needs code changes beyond configuration -> REPRODUCTION_REQUIRED / IMPLEMENTATION_UNAVAILABLE; continue the rest.
